main.description: Declares that a role exists, in the members space. The record key is the role id, of 64 characters at most. A role is deleted only once no member holds it and the permissions record grants it nothing.

default.description: Granted to members who join through requestJoin. With no role marked so, a newcomer gets member.

bot.description: People with this role are bots: accounts that act on their own, not a person. A member is a bot if any of their roles says so.
